summary: West Dennis lookout, Benewah County: a 10-foot L-4 tower built 1931, listed gone with no date; a 2022 visit found guide-wire supports and a benchmark.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone with no date in Kresek's book, as reported by Idaho Fire Lookouts. A September 2022 visit found guide-wire eye-hole supports, a lumber piece and a benchmark.

visit.trail_note: Short hike to the site, per a September 2022 Idaho Fire Lookouts post

events.note: 10-foot tower with an L-4 cab, per Rex's page (citing Kresek), firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts

evidence.supports: listed as gone, no date, in Kresek's book
evidence.quote: Listed as GONE,no date in Rey Kresek’s book Fire Lookout Towers of the Northwest

evidence.supports: visit described as a short hike to the site
evidence.quote: This was a short hike to the site of the lookout.

evidence.supports: remains found at the site in the 2022 visit
evidence.quote: We found the eye-hole supports for the guide wires, a single piece of lumber that was likely apart of the tower and a benchmark.

evidence.supports: forest listed as Clearwater National Forest (differs from St. Joe in cites 1 and 2)
list marks the tower as gone

sources.title: West Dennis - Forest Lookouts (Rex's Fire Lookout Page)
Idaho Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Rex's page and Firelookout.com give the St. Joe National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives the Clearwater National Forest. The story gives St. Joe and reports the Idaho Fire Lookouts listing.

notes_for_editor: Brief confirmed: 1931 build, L-4 cab, 10 ft (3.0 m), St. Joe NF, gone. No source gives a removal date, and no source states the site's access rules, so no access level is recorded (brief says unknown). No staffing source; the story leaves staffing out. The only description of the site today is the September 2022 Idaho Fire Lookouts post, which is one visit. East Dennis is a separate record and no source links the two, so the story does not mention it. No new photos found.
